title: matricaria maritima var. inodora
intro: Matricaria maritima var. inodora, commonly known as Sea Chamomile, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal and health-promoting properties, particularly for its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and calming effects. The health benefits of Sea Chamomile include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Sea Chamomile include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, antispasmodic, and antihistamine effects.
